data.spec: apps/speech/speaker_id.py (speech venv, sherpa-onnx + WeSpeaker ResNet34 ONNX, local, ~0.12 s/command). SpeakerID().enroll(name, *float32_16k_clips); .identify(audio) -> Match(name|None, score, best); Match.as_dict() -> {speaker: str|null, confidence: float}. Voiceprints in ignored .data/voiceprints.json (biometric data: consent-only, never commit). Identity is informational ("requested by"), NEVER approval authority. Not yet sent to the API: proposed optional speech_transcript payload field `speaker: {name: string|null, confidence: number}` — backend owner please confirm before I add it. stt.py --identify prints the speaker locally.
